summary: Suniti Kumar Chatterji was a linguist and Indologist who studied at Scottish Church College, Presidency University, Calcutta, London under Lionel David Barnett, and Paris under Jules Bloch. He served at Calcutta, London, Pennsylvania, and as National Professor in Humanities (1965–1977).

Sunny Kumar is an Indologist who completed his Ph.D. at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University (2013–2015). In 2016, he was appointed Assistant Professor at Gorakshanath Government Sanskrit College.
Supree Kanjanapisarn is a scholar of religious studies and philosophy. He earned his PhD at Assumption University under the supervision of Veerachart Nimanong (attested 2011).

Surabhi Verma specializes in Indology and philosophy. She completed her Ph.D. at Panjab University (2012–2015) and was appointed Assistant Professor at the National Institute of Technology Rourkela in 2015.

Surama Dasgupta (1907–1988) was an Indology and philosophy scholar. She studied under Surendranath Dasgupta, earned degrees from the University of Calcutta and a Ph.D. from Cambridge (1948), and served as Reader in Philosophy at the University of Lucknow.
Suren Naicker is a scholar of linguistics, Indology, and religious studies. He earned a D Litt et Phil from the University of South Africa and held a post there.
Surendra Man Bajracharya is a scholar in Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD from Tribhuvan University under the supervision of Bhadra Ratna Bajracharya and co-supervision of Ranjana Bajracharya.

Surendranath Dasgupta (1887–1952) was a philosopher and Indologist who studied at Calcutta and Cambridge under McTaggart and Ward. His posts included Principal of Sanskrit College, Lecturer at Cambridge, and Chair of Philosophy at Calcutta.
Surendranath Majumdar Sastri (1888–1921) was an Indologist and historian who studied under traditional teacher Hara Prasad Sastri. He served as a Reader at Patna University (attested 1924).

Suresha R. is an Indology and philosophy scholar. He was at the University of Mysore in 2013 and served as an Assistant Professor at Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (attested 2026).
Surya Das (born 1950) is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar. He studied at the University at Buffalo (1967–1971) and trained under traditional teacher Nyoshul Khenpo Rinpoche (~1984–1999).

Surya Kanta (1901–1980) was an Indologist and linguist. He studied under Frederick William Thomas and earned a D.Phil. at the University of Oxford (1937), later serving as Reader in Sanskrit at the University of the Punjab (attested 1939).

Surya Tahora is an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied at Aix-Marseille, INSEAD, Paris-Sud, and Arsha Vidya Gurukulam. In 2021, he served as Executive Director at S. P. Jain Institute of Management and Research.

Suryakumar Bhuyan (1894–1964) was an Indologist and historian educated at Cotton University, Presidency University, Calcutta, and SOAS (PhD 1936). He served as Principal of Cotton University and Vice Chancellor of Gauhati University (~1957–1960).

Suryanarayana Shukla (1895–1944) was a scholar of Indology, linguistics, and philosophy. He studied at Rajgopal Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya under Nandakishore Pandey, Ramanujacharya, and Shridatta Pandey, and served as a professor at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University.
Susan Andrews is a scholar of Buddhist studies and sinology. She completed her PhD at Columbia University (attested 2013) under the supervision of Chün-fang Yü.

Susan Hawthorne (born 1951) is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who studied at Melbourne Teachers' College, La Trobe University, University of Melbourne, and Australian National University. In 2018, she was an Adjunct Professor at James Cook University.
Susan J. Rosenfield is an Indologist who earned her PhD from Harvard University in 2004, where she studied under teachers including Stephanie W. Jamison, George L. Hart, and Kausalya Hart.
Susan L. Beningson is a scholar of sinology, history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at Columbia University under the supervision of Robert E. Harrist, Jr. (attested 2009).

Susan L. Huntington (born 1943) is an art historian and Indologist who earned her PhD from UCLA (~1967–1972). She served as Professor and later Distinguished University Professor, Emerita, at Ohio State University.
